intent: B3 of the final-release programme: the registry regroup and the URL renames of decisions 8, 11, 12 and 14. Pages move under src/app/{work,results,agent} per the plan's map; every old path answers 307 from next.config.ts redirects(); the registry is regrouped Home / Work / Results / Agent / Rec Room with an order field and becomes the single source of every page title and document.title (D55, D56 and the seven typed mismatches); the deploy buttons leave the rail; Quests and Help rows land with placeholder pages. Migration 038 operator_prefs with GET and PUT /api/prefs under a Zod allow-list. GET /api/status/runtime and the /agent/settings/system page (D109). The Settings index derived from a React-free src/lib/config-sections.ts with field search (D79). One rail, rendered once, inert closed on a phone and a dialog open, collapse persisted. Canary httpSurface changes wholesale and is blessed once from a reviewed diff.

reasons.evidence: migration 038 adds operator_prefs; no data loss
every page URL changes with a 307 from the old one; /api/* gains two routes and loses none

invariants: I1 The registry is the one source of navigation and naming: five sections in a fixed order, every link with an order, the merge deterministic; the rail, the e2e matrix, every page title and the tab title derive from it, and a page that passes a literal title passes the registry's word.
I2 Every old page path answers 307 to its new address with the query string intact, from next.config.ts, and no redirect is permanent. The specific /config paths are matched before the generic one.

I3 The config tree is not rail data. src/lib/config-sections.ts lists every CONFIG_SECTIONS id exactly once; the Settings index renders that list, prints the count it renders, carries Models, Restore and System, and searches every field.

I4 The rail is one aside: on a desktop the rail beside the page, on a phone the drawer over it, inert and aria-hidden while closed, a dialog named Navigation while open; it fits a 1280x720 viewport without scrolling; its collapsed state is a preference the operator keeps.

I5 Update, Rebuild and Restart are on Settings > System with every truth the block already told (the API off, a failed check, the log tail, the released buttons); the rail keeps a version line and an icon badge that links to System when origin is ahead.

I6 operator_prefs is one table behind an allow-list of six keys with a schema each; an unknown key or a wrong shape is a 400 that names the key; read-only refuses the write; the head is 38 and the ladder is checked over five rungs.

I7 GET /api/status/runtime says how the install is configured from the same readers the guards use and never carries a token; the System page shows it row by row and copies it as one block in the boot line's shape.
I8 The dashboard names the agent framework from the frameworks row, not a literal.
commits: 86ec8887 the oracle alone (7 unit suites, 2 Playwright specs, measured red: 27 failing assertions and five suites that could not resolve their modules); 539f3c1a the implementation (the moves, the codemod over 57 files, the new pages and routes, the migration, the canary re-blessed); a5609ffe the tab title from the server, found by the proof walk.
deviation: (1) Personalities is a sub-link of Agents rather than its own Agent row. The plan listed it as a row until B9 folds it into Agents; the 720px budget for the rail (tests/e2e/rail-no-scroll.spec.ts) is what decided it, and the sub-link keeps the page reachable and named. The oracle's Agent list was amended to say so before the implementation was gated. (2) Quests and Help render as a compact footer row rather than nav rows, which is what the plan's 'utility rows' meant and what the budget needed; they remain Home entries in the registry, so labelFor and the matrix see them. (3) The rail is one aside told apart by matchMedia rather than a tree portalled into a drawer: the same outcome (rendered once) with no portal and no second tree; the B2 drawer oracle was rewritten to that contract. (4) The runtime collector takes the agent's home from the route rather than importing the module, because core may not import a module (ADR-0005) and design-lint said so on the first lint. (5) The formatter and the shape of the runtime status live in a client-safe module apart from the collector, because the first build pulled fs and child_process into the System page's bundle through a value import. (6) The tab title is set on the server: the proxy passes the request path as x-ps-pathname and the root layout's generateMetadata resolves the registry's word for it. The plan said PageTitle would resolve it on the client, and the jsdom oracle was satisfied by that; the production build was not, because Next 16 streams the layout's metadata after hydration and React re-applies its <title> over the effect's document.title, so every fresh load read "PatterStage" (client transitions were fine). Every page is rendered dynamically as a consequence of headers() in the root layout; for a local console that is the right trade.
verification: Gate b3c on 539f3c1a's tree by exit code: tsc 0, jest 0 (4149 tests, 474 suites), knip 0, canary OK against the re-blessed golden, build 0, Playwright 128 passed, 0 failed, 8 skipped (was 101: the 21 redirect rows, the 2 rail rows, and the config-sections spec now visiting every /agent/settings section); its lint line was red on one rule, an 11px rail heading against no-sub-12px-type, corrected to 12px at the same line height. Two earlier gates found the rest: the first (b3) failed jest on ten older suites that read page source by its old on-disk path and the build on fs and child_process reaching the browser bundle; the second (b3b) failed only Playwright, on six heading names still spelling the old titles, one URL regex, and the rail's own budget at 720px. The final gate, on a5609ffe with this record, by exit code: lint 0 (agent-files, doc-links, derived views 113, read-only guards 168 handlers across 101 route files, icon-button names 75 icon-only across 387 buttons and 40 links with 0 unnamed and 0 nested, form-control names 101/0, design-lint 0 baselined, contrast 4 tiers, coverage floors held, eslint, typecheck:tests), tsc 0, jest 0 (4151 tests, 474 suites), knip 0, canary OK, build 0 (every page dynamic now, per deviation 6), Playwright 128 passed, 0 failed, 8 skipped.
mutation: 38 mutants against the committed tree (a5609ffe), 38 killed on the first pass: the registry's order and longest-match rules, the settings routes derived from the catalogue, a catalogue that drops a section, an unsorted rail, a permanent redirect, a dropped redirect, the generic /config rule listed first, a title that ignores the registry, an h1 that ignores the resolved title, a migration that never applies, a head left at 37, a preference schema widened to any, an unknown key admitted, an upsert turned into DO NOTHING, a PUT that ignores read-only or answers 200 to a bad body, a runtime status with a literal auth mode, port or read-only flag, a git failure that throws, a bug-report block without the schema line, a blind search, a missing tools row, a count off by one, a copy of JSON instead of the block, a System card without Retry, a deploy block that does not lock when the API is off, a rail never inert, always a dialog, never persisting or restoring its collapse, with a Home heading, with unnamed links, and a footer that never badges or never shows the version.
proof: Isolated instance (production build of a5609ffe, e2e-b1 data dir, mock-hermes 8747, mock-hindsight 9277), seven scenes, 36 checks, all PASS: (1) five old paths answer 307 to their new address with the query string intact, unauthenticated, and /work/missions answers 200 itself; (2) GET /api/status/runtime answers with schema 38 and the data directory and carries no token, PUT /api/prefs refuses an unknown key with 400 and stores sidebar.collapsed, GET reads it back; (3) at 1280x720 there is one aside, it comes up collapsed from the stored preference, expanding it writes the preference back, the headings read Work, Results, Agent, Rec Room in that order with no Home heading, the nav's scrollHeight equals its clientHeight (571px in a 720px viewport), no deploy button is in the rail and the footer shows v0.1.0 with the commit; (4) at 390x844 the same aside is inert while closed, a dialog named Navigation while open, and Escape closes it; (5) Settings > System is titled System in the h1 and the tab, shows the install rows (schema 38) and holds Check for updates, Rebuild and Restart; (6) the Settings index renders 27 section cards plus Restore and System, its subtitle says 27 sections, and searching 'reasoning' leaves exactly the two sections that carry the word (Agent, Display) with the matching field named on the card; (7) Sessions, Logs, Tools and Research are titled with the rail's word in the h1 and the tab. Screenshots: scratchpad walk-b3/{rail-1280x720,rail-collapsed,drawer-390,system,settings-search}.png. The walk found two real things and two of its own: real, the tab title never left 'PatterStage' on a fresh load (deviation 6), and the nav's 880px against 560px available at 720 tall, which the density changes in this record's deviations 1 and 2 brought to 571 against 571; its own, a heading selector that caught the Dashboard row, and a link count that caught the rail's Settings sub-links and expected one match for a word two sections carry.
harness_amendments: Fourteen older tests learned the new addresses or the new shape, none the product bending to them: the codemod rewrote quote-anchored route strings in 32 test files; nine tests that read page source by its on-disk path were pointed at the moved files (b2-confirm-button, b2-read-contract, composer-cancel-is-a-decision, composer-reject-is-not-a-cliff, console-shapes-and-dead-ends, feature-flag-route-is-dynamic, record-surface-containers, use-copy-to-clipboard); composer-cancel-is-a-decision pinned the head literal 37 and now holds the head to at least 037's gate; run-migrations-upgrade.integration checks the ladder over five rungs ending at 038; module-registry's exemption for /config is gone because the Settings index is a registry route; sidebar-config-models-link asserts the Agent row at /agent/models; b2-drawer-is-a-dialog asserts the single aside with matchMedia; b1-deploy-footer-tells-the-truth renders DeployControls where it rendered the rail's expanded view; personalities-have-no-active-control's navigation mock gained usePathname, since page headers read the registry for the current path; six Playwright specs assert the registry's words (Settings, Sessions, Skills, Tools, Create, Themes) and one the new Scripts URL. One B3 oracle over-matched ('backups' appears three times on the System page) and was tightened to the heading.
deferred: Personalities' page, nav entry and API go in B9 (decision 11); the remaining nav-label consumers (the Help deep-links, quest hrefs) arrive with B16 and B17 on labelFor; the Backups card on System is filled by B6; the docs' old-route prose is rewritten in B18 (the 307s keep every documented URL working meanwhile; ENV_REFERENCE and the walkthrough's deploy section were corrected now because they named the rail as the buttons' place).
